title: 第一卷 人生初见 第五章 红袖阁第一卷 人生初见 第六章 入阁礼
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
每天的第一束阳光划破天空，长孙准时睁眼，回府后长孙依旧保持着这个习惯，在外人看来每天午时长孙才会起床，只有每天早上给长孙送饭的初黎知道，每天长孙都起的很早。
长孙问天很是霸气的将丽山修成了自己的后花园，所以长孙府的后院就是丽山。
长孙奔跑在丽山的丛林间，一个多月来，长孙每天都会来后院跑步，体力有了明显的增长。
虽然已入寒秋，再过几日便入初冬，但后院耐寒的针叶松依旧遮天蔽日，长孙很喜欢在这里锻炼，清新的空气，虽然寒冷，但呼吸间并不刺喉，空气恍若甘泉一般滋润身心，令长孙渐渐喜欢上这个世界，一个原始而又神奇的世界。
跑完步后，长孙在一块巨石上坐下，凝神、收心，仿佛入定禅僧，“众生皆烦恼，烦恼皆苦。烦恼皆不生不灭，不垢不净，不增不减。有形者，生于无形，无能生有，有归于无。境由心生。静，以不动制万动。静，心则清，体则凉。喜、怒、哀、惊、乱、静全由心生。”这是大陆广为流传的静心咒。
长孙在心中默念，词字仿若泉水般流过心间，没过一会长孙便进入一种极静的状态。
一个月来，外人只知道长孙白天会让初黎出入藏经阁，但取回的也都是一些野史杂记。其实长孙自五岁开始就偷偷的出入藏经阁。
在长孙五岁那年，长孙的父母在一次带队外出任务中失踪，与此同时长孙也得了一场重病，昏迷不醒，长孙问天请了很多大夫都无计可施。最后长孙问天只得相信民间偏方，给长孙冲喜，也就是这样初黎成了长孙的童养媳。
然而让人们没想到的是，一场冲喜后长孙竟然真的醒了。但长孙也因为这次重病而失去了修炼的根基，自此成了人们背后议论的“废物少爷”。族老们极力反对长孙继续成为家族的下一位继承人，并且要求长孙问天续弦，这才有了现在这场家族内权利的纷争。
醒来后的长孙得知自己不能修炼，这在本就遭受失去双亲重创的长孙心里染上一抹灰暗。
不服输的长孙在夜里无数次的偷偷前往藏经阁，无数次的尝试。
最终事实的残酷击碎了幼小孩童的幻想。若想修炼，首先在入定之后要能感知到周围灵气的存在。
就仿佛一个孩子，刚生下来便双目失明，若想读书自然是一件困难的事，而长孙便是这样的“瞎子”。
因为那场重病使长孙阳魂受创，这使长孙想要入定都是一件困难的事，感知灵气的存在更是难上加难。
一个月前长孙再一次尝试感知灵气，让长孙没想到的是，当静心咒在心头流过时，他很快便入定。进入了以往无数次尝试才勉强成功的极静的状态。
长孙按捺住心中的兴奋，他有强烈的预感，因为三个多月前的那次经历，这次的尝试会有变化。
长孙小心翼翼的将自己的精神外放，就像是刚出生的婴儿第一次睁眼看世界，长孙也是第一次见到这个神奇的世界，他看到一片虚无之海，海面上漂浮着一点一点荧光，这片荧光将他紧紧围绕，仿佛置身星空。
“这便是书中说的星海。”长孙在心里感慨道，长孙在翻阅有关修炼的书籍时曾不止一次的在心中幻想星海的模样，但此时眼前的场景依旧震惊了长孙，那一点点荧光恍若星辰，缓慢洒落人间变为点点微光。在一片虚无中长孙却并无孤独的感觉，被包绕在荧光中央仿佛沐浴清晨的阳光，又仿佛回到了温暖的襁褓。
长孙小心翼翼的牵引着周围的灵气入体，灵气随着长孙的一呼一吸间进入他的体内，随着一条经脉慢慢汇入丹田中，这条经脉长孙在书中看到过，人们将他称为“星途”。
刚修炼的人经脉堵塞，需要在修炼中不断疏通，但通常修炼之初总会有一条经脉连接外界与丹田，人们便将这条经脉称为“星途”。

长孙努力牵引着灵气入体遁着星途的轨迹进入丹田，但最后也只有不到一半的灵气汇聚到了丹田内，长孙发现这些灵气入体后就如同起了玩心的孩子，无论长孙如何努力控制总会有一大半的灵气从星途散入体内。但长孙并无恼意。
从书中长孙了解到武者被分为行者，术者，御者，圣者，凡者，尊者。人们有这样一句话形容行者之境，“苦行千里，终成行者。”行者是一个不断积累的过程，也正是因此才有了这样一句话，当丹田内灵气第一次达到饱和时，数量巨大的灵气会以一种暴力的形式从丹田内向体外溢出，以此方式疏通经脉，淬炼筋骨，所以淬炼的过程也是极其痛苦的，这也便是为什么人们说是苦行千里。
如此过程要反复三次才算修得圆满。
行者之境圆满后，堵塞的经脉得以疏通，方可做到真气离体，才可修炼各种法术神通，进入术者之境。此时武者的神通方可略显一二。
在长孙看来，行者便是筑基的过程，虽然每次进入体内的灵气有大半都消散于体内，只有少半进入丹田，但长孙可以感觉到灵气并未从体内散出，只是被身体吸收或者藏匿于某处。
即使长孙两世为人，依旧难以抑制心中的兴奋，虽然这只是个开始，但至少长孙看到了希望。
整理好心情，长孙知道现在能够修炼这件事不能让别人知道，尤其是华夫人。以她的性格，如若知晓肯定会先一步把长孙扼杀在摇篮里。
长孙从入定中醒来，一个多月的修炼，让长孙获益匪浅，虽然每天只是重复着同样的过程，但长孙能够明显的感觉到身体的变化。如今丹田内的灵气仅仅聚集了三分之一，但身体的变化却是明显的，长孙能够感觉到身体的每一个组织，每一个细胞就仿佛干涸了多年的土地，藏匿在体内的灵气如同甘泉一般滋润着身体，再加上长孙每天不断的锻炼，如今的长孙再也不是一名手无缚鸡之力的富家公子了。
回到房间里，初黎已经将饭菜准备好，用过早餐后长孙开始阅读从藏经阁内取来的野史杂记，这些书虽然并非修炼的书籍，却可以帮助长孙理解这个世界，长孙可以通过这些记载从侧面了解这个世界是如何使用力量的。
到了午时，长孙放下手中的书，见时辰不早，收拾收拾，提起放在桌旁的鸟笼出了房间，准时出府。
长孙走在热闹的大街上，手中提着鸟笼，时不时的望一望街边的摊位，身后还跟着两名家丁，俨然一副富家子弟的模样。
content_en:
The first ray of sunshine every day breaks through the sky, and the eldest grandson opens his eyes on time. After returning home, the eldest grandson still maintains this habit. To outsiders, it seems that the eldest grandson only gets up at noon every day. Only Chu Li, who delivers meals to the eldest grandson every morning, knows that the eldest grandson wakes up very early every day.
Changsun Wentian was very domineering and built Lishan as his own back garden, so the backyard of Changsun Mansion was Lishan.
The eldest grandson runs in the jungle of Lishan. For more than a month, the eldest grandson comes to the backyard to run every day, and his physical strength has increased significantly.
Although it has already entered cold autumn and will enter early winter in a few days, the cold-resistant coniferous pines in the backyard still block the sky and the sun. The eldest grandson likes to exercise here very much. Although the fresh air is cold, it does not hurt the throat when breathing. The air is like a sweet spring that nourishes the body and mind. The eldest grandson gradually likes this world, a primitive and magical world.
After finishing his run, the eldest grandson sat down on a huge stone, concentrating and gathering his mind, as if he were a Zen monk. "All living beings are troubled, and all troubles are suffering. All troubles are neither born nor destroyed, neither dirty nor pure, neither increasing nor decreasing. The tangible is born from nothingness. Form, nothingness, nothingness, state arises from the mind. Silence controls all movements. When the mind is still, the mind becomes clear, and the body becomes cool. "This is a meditation mantra that is widely circulated in China.
The eldest grandson recited silently in his heart, and the words flowed through his heart like spring water. After a while, the eldest grandson entered a state of extreme tranquility.
For a month, outsiders only knew that Changsun would let Chu Li enter and leave the Scripture Pavilion during the day, but all he got back were some miscellaneous notes on unofficial history. In fact, the eldest grandson has been secretly entering and leaving the Sutra Pavilion since he was five years old.
When the eldest grandson was five years old, the eldest grandson's parents disappeared during a mission. At the same time, the eldest grandson also fell seriously ill and fell into a coma. The eldest grandson asked many doctors but nothing could be done. In the end, the eldest grandson Wentian had no choice but to believe in folk remedies and bring happiness to the eldest grandson. In this way, Chu Li became the eldest grandson's child bride.
However, what people didn't expect was that the grandson actually woke up after a happy event. However, the eldest grandson also lost the foundation of cultivation because of this serious illness, and since then he has become the "good-for-nothing young master" that people talk about behind his back. The clan elders strongly opposed the eldest grandson becoming the next heir of the family, and demanded that the eldest grandson Wentian continue his marriage. This is why the current power dispute within the family has arisen.
After waking up, the eldest grandson learned that he could not practice cultivation. This put a touch of gloom in the heart of the eldest grandson who had already suffered the heavy loss of his parents.
Unwilling to admit defeat, the eldest grandson secretly went to the Sutra Pavilion countless times at night and tried countless times.
In the end, the cruelty of the facts shattered the illusions of young children. If you want to practice, you must first be able to sense the presence of spiritual energy around you after entering concentration.
It is like a child who is blind right after birth. It is naturally difficult for him to study. The eldest grandson is such a "blind man".
Because the serious illness had traumatized Changsun Yanghun, it was difficult for Changsun to enter samadhi, and it was even more difficult for Changsun to sense the existence of spiritual energy.
A month ago, Changsun once again tried to sense spiritual energy. What Changsun didn't expect was that when the meditation mantra flowed through his heart, he quickly fell into meditation. He entered a state of extreme tranquility that he had barely succeeded in countless attempts in the past.
Changsun suppressed the excitement in his heart. He had a strong feeling that because of the experience more than three months ago, this attempt would be different.
The eldest grandson carefully let his spirit out, just like a newborn baby opening his eyes to see the world for the first time. The eldest grandson also saw this magical world for the first time. He saw a sea of ​​nothingness, with little bits of fluorescence floating on the sea. This fluorescence surrounded him tightly, as if he was in the starry sky.
"This is the sea of ​​​​stars mentioned in the book." Changsun sighed in his heart. When he was reading books about cultivation, he had fantasized about the sea of ​​stars more than once. But the scene in front of him still shocked him. The little fluorescent lights were like stars, slowly falling into the world and turning into little glimmers of light. existIn the midst of nothingness, the eldest grandchild does not feel lonely. Being wrapped in the fluorescent center seems to be bathing in the morning sunshine, and he seems to have returned to a warm swaddling clothes.
Changsun carefully pulled the surrounding spiritual energy into his body. The spiritual energy entered his body with each breath of Changsun, and slowly merged into his Dantian along with a meridian. Changsun had seen this meridian in the book, and people called him "Star Road".
People who have just started to practice have blocked meridians and need to constantly clear them during practice. However, usually at the beginning of practice, there is always a meridian connecting the outside world and the Dantian, and people call this meridian the "Star Road."
The eldest grandson tried hard to draw the spiritual energy into his body and follow the trajectory of the star path into the dantian, but in the end, less than half of the spiritual energy gathered in the dantian. The eldest grandson found that after these spiritual energy entered the body, he was like a playful child. No matter how hard the eldest grandson tried to control, more than half of the spiritual energy would always escape from the star path into the body. But the eldest grandson was not annoyed.
Changsun learned from the book that warriors are divided into practitioners, magicians, charioteers, saints, mortals, and venerables. People have such a saying to describe the state of a practitioner, "A journey of asceticism for thousands of miles will eventually make you a practitioner." Being a practitioner is a process of continuous accumulation, which is why there is such a saying. When the spiritual energy in the Dantian reaches saturation for the first time, a huge amount of spiritual energy will overflow from the Dantian to the outside of the body in a violent form.
This process must be repeated three times before the practice is complete.
After the practitioner's realm is perfected, the blocked meridians can be cleared, and the true energy can be separated from the body. Only then can you practice various magical powers and enter the magician's realm. At this time, the warrior's magical power can be slightly revealed.
In Changsun's view, walking is the process of building a foundation. Although most of the spiritual energy that enters the body is dissipated in the body each time, and only a small part enters the Dantian, Changsun can feel that the spiritual energy does not escape from the body, but is only absorbed by the body or hidden somewhere.
Even though the eldest grandson has been a human being for two generations, it is still difficult to suppress the excitement in his heart. Although this is just the beginning, at least the eldest grandson sees hope.
After sorting out his mood, Changsun knew that he could not let others know that he was able to practice now, especially Mrs. Hua. With her character, if she had known about it, she would have strangled her eldest grandson in the cradle.
The eldest grandson woke up from trance. More than a month of practice has benefited the eldest grandson a lot. Although he just repeats the same process every day, the eldest grandson can clearly feel the changes in his body. Nowadays, only one-third of the spiritual energy in the Dantian has been gathered, but the changes in the body are obvious. The eldest grandson can feel every tissue of the body, and every cell is like land that has been dry for many years. The spiritual energy hidden in the body nourishes the body like a sweet spring. Coupled with the eldest grandson's continuous exercise every day, the eldest grandson is no longer a rich young man with no strength.
Back in the room, Chu Li had already prepared the meal. After breakfast, the eldest grandson began to read the unofficial notes taken from the Sutra Pavilion. Although these books were not cultivation books, they could help the eldest grandson understand the world. Through these records, the eldest grandson could understand from the side how power is used in the world.
At noon, the eldest grandson put down the book in his hand. Seeing that it was late, he packed up, picked up the birdcage beside the table and left the room, leaving the house on time.
The eldest grandson was walking on the busy street, holding a birdcage in his hand and looking at the stalls on the street from time to time. There were two servants following behind him, making him look like a boy from a rich family.
